 Download Now CBSE Class 10, 12 date sheet 2027 Live Updates (Representative Image: Shutterstock) The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) will release Class 10 and 12 date sheet 2027 soon on its official website, cbse.gov.in. Students can expect the CBSE board exam date 2027 anyday now. The board has completed the regular submission window for the CBSE 2027 candidate list submission for the 2026-27 academic session.

 Also See: Foreign Universities in India | Liverpool | York | Bristol | Victoria 
 Free Study Material for Class 12th: Boards & JEE |  Boards & NEET 
 Schools that missed the deadline can submit CBSE candidate list with a late fee until October 30, 2026. The CBSE LOC submission process began on September 24, 2026, and the regular deadline was October 21.
 However, the board has not announced the confirmed subject-wise CBSE Class 10, 12 schedule 2027. The subject-wise CBSE 2027 exam timetable schedule will include examination dates, subject names, subject codes and exam timings for students appearing in the 2027 board examinations.
 Also read UP Board Exam Centre List 2027: Objections to 7,526 proposed centres for Classes 10, 12 open till October 28 
 How to download CBSE date sheet 2027
 Students can follow these steps to download the Class 10 and Class 12 timetable once it is released:
 Visit the official CBSE website at cbse.gov.in.
 Open the latest announcements or examination circulars section.
 Click on the link for the CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 date sheet 2027.
 The timetable PDF will appear on the screen.
 Check the subject-wise examination dates, subject codes and timings.
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference.
 The CBSE Class 10 and 12 board exams are generally conducted during February and March. However, the exact CBSE date sheet 2027 will be known only after the board releases the official schedule.
CBSE Class 10 students should also note that the board has introduced a two-examination system. Students should check the official notification for the applicable examination schedule and rules for the 2027 session.
